text:
The '''2005–06 Liga de Fútbol Profesional Boliviano''' was the first Bolivian football league to use the European calendar format. However, it was quickly changed after issues with relegation occurring in the middle of the season instead of the end.
==Torneo Apertura==
The first part of the season was divided into two groups. The top three of each group advanced to a final group stage known as the Hexagonal Final.

==Promotion/relegation==
Due to issues with the second division and changing to the European season format, a relegation was held in the middle of the season between the Apertura and Clausura. {{ill|Club Universidad Iberoamericana|es|Club Iberoamericana|lt=Universidad Iberoamericana}} was relegated and [[Club Destroyers|Destroyers]] played a promotion relegation playoff against [[Guabirá]]. [[Club Universitario de Sucre|Universitario]] was promoted to the Torneo Clausura.
